topic: Coordinated COVER capacity actual-owner parent binding
finding: Capacity acknowledgement and consumption compared an HC owner epoch with the server private CBE_AIPass_Epoch. Both counters change locally, so a valid report could be rejected without any ammunition shortage.
implementation: Version2 appends the actual support parent generation to the existing finite owner observation. Owner publication verifies its local parent, private epoch, generation, owner, token and original expiry.

The authenticated server receiver and MOVE consumer compare generation/epoch with the existing published COORDINATED_ASSAULT parent, supportOwner with the current group owner, and the exact support token/original lease expiry. CANCELLED, missing, replaced and mismatched parents refuse.
Direct private epoch comparison remains mandatory for server-local groups only. No private counter is broadcast or overwritten.

Exact lease/role/sender authentication, accepted reservation, finite numeric counts, original observation/lease/job deadlines and delayed-observation rewind checks remain. Parent replication delay refuses until a later ordinary report; it never grants a grace period or new deadline.
Existing capacity is ammunition availability for the moving helper, not immediate weapon readiness or proof another squad is delivering covering fire.
cost: One additional number per existing owner capacity message. Bounded parent metadata reads at current maintenance/receipt/selection points; no new actor enumeration, network endpoint, query, worker, polling schedule or timer. Existing <=64 actors /2-second report cadence and <=6 responders retained. Runtime delta unmeasured.
limits: In-engine normal and HC behaviour, delayed replication, repeated migration and actual firepower still require physical validation. Audits remain paused.

This binds observations to available published state, not an atomic cross-machine owner-ready snapshot. Same-owner return before a newer parent reaches the server remains subject to existing bounded six-second report freshness; no claim of eliminating all replication windows.
No whole-mod parity, tactical acceptance or performance-budget claim.
